_notes: Sample subtitle timing for the Arabic preset (use only to test; real films get theirs from modules/narration-sync). Each chunk: a/b seconds, ar = Arabic verbatim, en = translation.

chunks.ar: في ليلة صافية، كان القمر يضيء بيوت المدينة.
chunks.en: On a clear night, the moon lit up the houses of the city.

chunks.ar: لكنَّ صاحب البيت سَمِعَ خطواتهم. فتح عينيه بهدوء، ثم أَيْقَظَ زوجته وهَمَسَ: «هناك لُصوص فوق السطح. لا تخافي، عندي فكرة».
chunks.en: But the owner of the house heard their footsteps. He quietly opened his eyes, then woke his wife and whispered, "There are thieves on the roof. Don't be afraid. I have an idea."
